description: Available Microsoft Power Apps Canvas App controls

controls.name: Button
controls.description: A control the user can click or tap to interact with the app

controls.name: Text input
controls.description: A box in which the user can type text, numbers, and other data

controls.name: Drop down
controls.description: A list that conserves screen space, especially when the list contains a large number of choices

controls.name: Combo box
controls.description: A control that allows users to make selections from pre-defined choices, supports search and multi-select

controls.name: List box
controls.description: A list in which the user can select one or multiple items

controls.name: Check box
controls.description: A control that the user can select or clear to indicate true or false

controls.name: Radio
controls.description: An input control that shows multiple options, of which users can select only one at a time

controls.name: Toggle
controls.description: A control that the user can turn on or off by moving its handle

controls.name: Slider
controls.description: A control with which the user can specify a value by dragging a handle

controls.name: Rating
controls.description: A control in which the user can indicate a value between 1 and a maximum number that you specify

controls.name: Date picker
controls.description: A control that the user can click or tap to specify a date

controls.name: Pen input
controls.description: A control in which the user can draw, erase, and highlight areas of an image

controls.name: Rich text editor
controls.description: Allows end users to format text inside a WYSIWYG editing area

controls.name: Address input
controls.description: An input control that provides address suggestions as the user types

controls.name: Label
controls.description: A box that shows data such as text, numbers, dates, or currency

controls.name: HTML text
controls.description: Shows HTML tags formatted as HTML in a Canvas app

controls.name: Image
controls.description: A control that shows an image from a local file or a data source

controls.name: Timer
controls.description: A control that can determine how your app responds after a certain amount of time passes

controls.name: PDF viewer
controls.description: An experimental control that shows the content of a PDF file

controls.name: Power BI tile
controls.description: A control that shows a Power BI tile inside an app

Layout.description: Controls for organizing and structuring app layout

controls.name: Gallery - Vertical
controls.description: A control that contains other controls and shows a set of data in vertical layout

controls.name: Gallery - Horizontal
controls.description: A control that contains other controls and shows a set of data in horizontal layout

controls.name: Gallery - Flexible height
controls.description: A vertical gallery with rows that adjust to content height

controls.name: Data table
controls.description: A control that shows data in a tabular format

controls.name: Edit form
controls.description: A control for editing or creating a record in a data source

controls.name: Display form
controls.description: A control for displaying (read-only) a record from a data source

Media.description: Controls for media capture and playback

controls.name: Camera
controls.description: A control with which the user can take photos by using the camera on the device

controls.name: Video
controls.description: A control that plays a video clip from a local file, a data source, or YouTube

controls.name: Audio
controls.description: A control that plays a sound clip from a local file or a data source

controls.name: Barcode scanner
controls.description: A control that scans barcodes, QR codes, and data-matrix codes on Android and iOS devices

controls.name: Add picture
controls.description: A control to load images from the local device

controls.name: Attachments
controls.description: A control that allows users to download files and upload or delete files from their device

controls.name: Column chart
controls.description: A control that shows data as vertical bars

controls.name: Line chart
controls.description: A control that shows data as a series of data points connected by lines

controls.name: Pie chart
controls.description: A control that shows relative values of up to five values as slices of a whole circle

controls.name: Bar chart
controls.description: A control that shows data as horizontal bars

controls.name: Icon
controls.description: Graphic icons including arrows, geometric shapes, actions, and symbols

controls.name: Rectangle
controls.description: A shape used for visual elements and backgrounds

controls.name: Circle
controls.description: A circle shape used for visual elements

controls.name: Triangle
controls.description: A triangle shape used for visual elements

controls.name: Map
controls.description: Displays a map with pins for locations using Bing Maps
